scope: Forge 47.4.10 development client with same-ID fixture items, installed Grilling, Cookery, ImmersiveEating, GeckoLib, Embeddium and Mekalus. Both complete twelve-item runs use a window hidden before creation and disabled shaders, with slim and Steve arms, base interactions and rapid selection tests. All 24 hand masks and native skin/sleeve meshes validated for both hand sizes and dominant hands. 48 Blockbench projects exported from 1.6.4 runtime transforms. Brandy carries at the normal side grip, transfers to symmetric palms for centered drinking; Glass wines preserve original negative dimensions, original textures and culled inward faces, including restored XO, rum and coconut shells; repaired openings and opaque beer necks remain. Timing, bottle dimensions and sounds are preserved; force-continuous reversals, launch/catch velocity, facet holds, four swallow responses and camera endpoints are tested. Runtime liquid inertia and polygon clipping are not reproduced in Blockbench. Full modpack not tested.
